summary: Two screens plus a cross-cutting relationship graph. PORTAFOGLIO (portale.html markup 1397-1424, logic 3026-3047) is already clean: it lists AM.products (166 = 163 real registrations + BUDGE/EXELGROW/PARLEAF which are catalog-only) in two deliberately separate tabs, CATALOGO COMMERCIALE (44 catalog items) and UNIVERSO REGOLATORIO (163 registrations), filtered by categoryLabel (ERBICIDI 91 / FUNGICIDI 46 / INSETTICIDI 23 / SPECIALI 6). PRODUCT INTELLIGENCE (markup 1339-1395, logic 2999-3023) shows one product's identity plus three relationship cards (verified / check-needed / not-confirmed) and a separate "VEDI OPPORTUNITÀ COLLEGATE" CTA. The identity facts are real (IG.PRODUCTS: name, reg, holder, ai, form, regCat, line, status, expiry, hrac/frac/irac, labelUrl — 163/163 populated). The RELATIONSHIPS are not: italy-app-model.js line 102 builds every product link by walking D.CASES[].productLinks, so which crop x issue x product triples exist at all is decided by a demo fixture (29 demo cases, 80 links). window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS — the real 163-label audit — is loaded but italy-app-model.js never reads it; only italy-demo-data.js line 281 calls LV.verdict() to GRADE the fixture's own candidate list. The measured consequence: 57 distinct triples, of which 42 are LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED invented by the fixture; the visible 10 / 10 / 9 is the portfolioState of the 29 demo opportunity cards.
realSource: APP.productRelationships (new canonical collection) fed, in precedence order, by: (1) ITALY_CANONICAL.windows[].PRODUCT_MATCHES — MEASURED EMPTY: all 29 windows have PRODUCT_MATCHES = [], so this tier contributes 0 rows today and exists only so the next HANDOFF load lights it up; (2) window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS — 12 VERIFIED triples + 7 NOT_FOUND triples, audit date 2026-09-02, source "Claude Code reading of 163 official Italian product labels"; (3) IG.LINKS — 219 rows, all prov REAL_FACT / evidence REGULATORY_FACT, carrying crop enum + Latin target + product + reg + ai + moa + labelUrl, covering only 19 distinct products; (4) IG.PRODUCTS[].crops + [].line for the RELATED_PORTFOLIO tier. Product identity keeps coming from IG.PRODUCTS (163) joined to ITALY_CATALOG.ITEMS (44, matchState REGULATORY_MATCH_CONFIRMED 41 / NOT_FOUND 3). Windows come from AM.collections.windows (29 canonical), never D.WINDOWS.

modelChanges.collection: productRelationships (NEW, in AM.collections and as AM.productRelationships)
modelChanges.why: One canonical relationship truth so no view can invent, promote or hide a portfolio match. Replaces the D.CASES walk at italy-app-model.js:102. Every record answers three questions the screen must be able to show: which product, against which window, and on what evidence.
fields: region (from the window, never from the label — a label is national)
target (Latin target from IG.LINKS, null for audit/registration tiers)
mappingRule (which crop-key row and which issue-target row produced this record; null for tiers 1-2)
modelChanges.derivation: Iterate the 29 ITALY_CANONICAL.windows. TIER 1 CANONICAL: window.PRODUCT_MATCHES — MEASURED [] on all 29, so 0 rows today; keep the reader. TIER 2 LABEL_AUDIT: for each (crop, issue) match against ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS.VERIFIED -> VERIFIED_LABEL_MATCH, and against .NOT_FOUND -> NO_CONFIRMED_MATCH_CURRENT_READING; needs an issue-alias table because the audit writes 'Cereal Aphids' and 'Cereal Aphids / BYDV Risk' where the window writes 'Cereal Aphids · BYDV Risk', and 'Diabrotica' where the window writes 'Diabrotica Adults'. Yields 14 verified rows and 15 not-confirmed rows across the 29 windows. TIER 3 REGULATORY_USE_ROW: IG.LINKS rows where LINK.crop is in CROP_KEY[window.CROP_NAME] and LINK.target matches ISSUE_TARGET[window.ISSUE_NAME], and the product was not already graded by tier 2 -> LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED. Yields 15 rows. TIER 4 CROP_REGISTRATION: IG.PRODUCTS where p.crops intersects CROP_KEY[window.CROP_NAME] AND p.line matches the window ISSUE_TYPE (PEST->INSETICIDA, DISEASE->FUNGICIDA, WEED->HERBICIDA), not already graded -> RELATED_PORTFOLIO. Yields 321 rows. WITHOUT the line gate this tier yields 1261 rows (a grapevine herbicide 'related' to Flavescenza Dorata) — the gate is mandatory.

modelChanges.why: The three real sources speak three crop vocabularies and nothing upstream joins them. Making the join a visible, named table stops each view from inventing its own string match.
modelChanges.derivation: Hand-authored from the measured value sets: CANON.CROP_NAME has Grapevine, Maize, Olive, Sugar Beet, Wheat, Durum Wheat, Apple, Tomato, Rice, Soybean; IG.LINKS.crop has SUGARBEET, WHEAT_GENERIC, SORGHUM, SOYBEAN, TOMATO, POTATO, TRITICALE, BARLEY, MAIZE, GRAPEVINE, COMMON_WHEAT, APPLE, OLIVE, RICE; IG.CROPS adds DURUM_WHEAT, SUNFLOWER, ALFALFA. One judgement call must be recorded in `note`: Wheat -> [COMMON_WHEAT, WHEAT_GENERIC] and Durum Wheat -> [DURUM_WHEAT, WHEAT_GENERIC]. MEASURED: DURUM_WHEAT has PRODUCTS_WITH_USE_ROW_READ = 0, so every Durum Wheat check-needed row would come from the WHEAT_GENERIC ('Frumento') label rows.

modelChanges.collection: ISSUE_TARGET (new lookup exported on AM, provenance REAL_DERIVED, explicitly labelled as a Sintonia mapping)
modelChanges.why: IG.LINKS targets are Latin species ('Cercospora beticola', 'Zymoseptoria tritici'); canonical windows name issues in English ('Cercospora Leaf Spot', 'Septoria Leaf Blotch'). Nothing upstream connects them. This is the ONLY hand-authored input in the whole rebuild and it must be visible as such, versioned, and attached to every row it produces via `mappingRule`.
modelChanges.derivation: 22 distinct window issues. MEASURED: only 6 of them have any matching target in the 219 use rows — Diabrotica Adults/Larvae (Diabrotica virgifera, MAIZE), Cercospora Leaf Spot (Cercospora beticola, SUGARBEET), Septoria Leaf Blotch (Zymoseptoria tritici / Septoria tritici, COMMON_WHEAT + WHEAT_GENERIC), Fusarium Head Blight (Fusarium spp, COMMON_WHEAT), Grass weed complex (Digitaria/Echinochloa/Sorghum halepense, MAIZE), Herbicide resistance · rice (Leersia/Glyceria/Echinochloa, RICE). The other 16 issues — including Flavescenza Dorata (Scaphoideus titanus), European Corn Borer (Ostrinia), Olive Fruit Fly (Bactrocera oleae), Codling Moth (Cydia), Grapevine Moth (Lobesia), Downy Mildew (Plasmopara), Tomato Leafminer (Tuta), Powdery Mildew, Wheat Rusts, Mycotoxin Risk — have ZERO matching use rows. If the engineer does not want a hand-authored table at all, tier 3 is dropped and the whole check-needed class goes to 0 rows / 0 windows; the spec's counts assume the table exists.

risks: The rebuild's headline number gets WORSE, and that is the point. Window-level portfolio state goes from 10 VERIFIED / 10 LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED / 9 NO_CONFIRMED (measured today, on the 29 opportunity cards) to 12 VERIFIED / 6 LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED / 10 RELATED_PORTFOLIO / 1 NO_CONFIRMED. Verified goes UP (12 vs 10, because 4 audited verified triples were never reachable through the fixture and 2 fixture cards claimed verified without one), but 10 cards drop to the pale-blue RELATED_PORTFOLIO state and one card — Maize · Mycotoxin Risk, IT-WIN-0021 — ends with nothing at all, because no ADAMA fungicide is registered on maize in the 163 rows and 'Mycotoxin Risk' is not a label target. Anyone expecting the screen to get denser will read this as a regression.

The ISSUE_TARGET table is the one hand-authored input in the entire chain and it decides 15 of the 44 evidence-backed rows. If it is written loosely it manufactures matches; if it is written tightly it starves the check-needed class. It must be versioned, attributed, and surfaced per row via mappingRule — otherwise the rebuild replaces a demo fixture with an undocumented human judgement, which is the same defect wearing a better coat.

The RELATED_PORTFOLIO tier is enormous and low-value: 321 rows over 29 windows, with individual windows carrying up to 38 related products (Durum Wheat · Resistant grass weeds). It must be collapsed in the UI (a count plus a 'see all' link), never rendered as a list, or the screens become unreadable and the four-class hierarchy loses meaning.

Tier 1 is empty. The precedence 'HANDOFF V2.1 canonical > verified label verdict' is honoured in code but contributes nothing today: all 29 canonical windows have PRODUCT_MATCHES = []. Do not describe the result as canonical-backed. The strongest real evidence in the system is a 12-verified / 7-not-found audit of 163 labels, dated 2026-09-02, whose own SCOPE_NOTE says it verified the main visible claims and not every connection.

The label audit is small relative to the screens it governs: 19 audited triples against 29 windows and 166 products. Its NOT_FOUND set is 7 triples covering 6 products, and three of those seven are the same claim (Olive Fruit Fly) repeated across three windows — so a single audit row drives three cards to the palest state.

IG.LINKS covers 19 of 163 products. IG.CROPS states the gap explicitly and it is severe: GRAPEVINE has 61 products mentioning the crop and 1 with a use row read; DURUM_WHEAT has 14 and 0. Any check-needed count computed from use rows is a floor, not a measurement of the portfolio.

Deep links break. The competitor-product route ('cproduct') currently addresses 14 demo names; the real set is 36 different names. Old ids, bookmarks and any in-page chip pointing at Belanty/Revysol/Movento will 404 unless a fallback is added.

Four different ADAMA legal entities hold the 163 registrations (ADAMA ITALIA 85, ADAMA AGAN 35, ADAMA MAKHTESHIM 26, ADAMA DEUTSCHLAND 17) while the catalog is the Italian commercial site. Do not merge holder and seller into one 'ADAMA has this product' claim, and keep the two Portafoglio tabs separate — 41 of 44 catalog items match a registration, 3 (BUDGE, EXELGROW, PARLEAF, all SPECIALI) do not and are marked REGULATORY_MATCH_NOT_FOUND upstream.

15 of the 163 registrations have an expiry earlier than the 2026-09-02 reference date and 41 expire before 2027-01-01. Nothing in the current portfolio screens reads expiry. Surfacing a verified label match for an expired authorisation would be a new, avoidable false claim — worth guarding even though it is outside the strict scope of this migration.

D.CASES remains the source of the 29 opportunity objects even after relationships are rebuilt. This spec removes the demo from PRODUCT RELATIONSHIPS only; the opportunity/radar domain owner must handle the rest, and until then the relationship layer will be correct while the card it sits inside is still a scenario.
openQuestions: Is the ISSUE_TARGET mapping (English issue name -> Latin label target) acceptable as a Sintonia-authored artefact, or must it come from upstream? If it must come from upstream, tier 3 disappears and the result is 12 verified / 0 check-needed / 16 related / 1 no-confirmed across the 29 windows.

Should Durum Wheat inherit the WHEAT_GENERIC ('Frumento') use rows? DURUM_WHEAT itself has 0 use rows read. Inheriting adds check-needed candidates on two Durum Wheat windows; not inheriting leaves them related-only. This is an agronomic/regulatory call, not an engineering one.

Should RELATED_PORTFOLIO be gated more tightly than crop + product line? A tighter gate (e.g. same MoA family as an already-verified product) would cut the 321 rows sharply but adds another authored rule.
The 'region' line under each relationship card: relabel it as the window's region, or delete it? A label authorisation has no region.

Does the competitor-product view survive at all? IG.COMP_PRODUCTS has four fields. If crops/issues/dates cannot be derived from the 102 product-bearing activities, the view becomes a name, a company, an ad count and a proof string — which may be better folded into the company page than kept as its own route.

Is a fifth state (NOT_ASSESSED) acceptable alongside the four mandated strength classes, or must 'nothing has been looked at' be expressed as LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED? Collapsing it into LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED would put ~53 products and every unmatched triple into the amber class and re-inflate the number the rebuild is meant to deflate.
